Fractal Sexta

A personal fork of Fractal, the GNOME Matrix client. Install it alongside the official app, with separate accounts and settings.

Install Fractal Sexta · Add the Flatpak repository

Rolling x86_64 builds publish after checks pass on the main branch. This publicly downloadable repository is independently maintained and uses the GNOME nightly runtime.

Install from the terminal

flatpak install --user https://yamada-sexta.github.io/fractal-sexta/fractal-sexta.flatpakref
flatpak run io.github.yamada_sexta.FractalSexta//nightly

Update

flatpak update --user

Packages and repository metadata are signed. The public signing key and fingerprint are available for inspection.
